name: Clara G
description: Clara Gromaches trained as an architect and has spent the last six years working in the blockchain ecosystem. She now works on the mechanisms communities need to own and care for what they hold in common. At Komma, a research and relational-technology collective, she works with communities and institutions to design, pilot and test the legal, economic, cultural and technical systems that make this possible, starting with land and housing, and using AI and web3 where they're the right tool.
